headline: Illinois College's Attempt to Cancel Flock Safety Camera Contract Fails
summary: Elgin Community College installed Flock safety cameras, later expressing privacy concerns. The college attempted to cancel its contract due to data sharing issues with CBP. However, Flock refused the cancellation, sparking data security controversy.

headline: Silicon Valley Adopts Trump's 'Super Intelligence' AI Rebrand
summary: President Trump proposed rebranding Artificial Intelligence as 'super intelligence'. Despite public skepticism, some powerful Silicon Valley figures are aligning with this new terminology. This move indicates an unexpected acceptance of Trump's AI renaming effort.

headline: New Apple TV Rumored to Feature Built-in Mic, Speaker Remote
summary: Rumors suggest the upcoming Apple TV will include a built-in microphone for enhanced control. The refreshed remote is also expected to integrate a speaker for potential new functionalities. These features could enable hands-free Siri commands and expand smart home integration.

headline: NASA Releases Over 800GB of Artemis II Mission Data
summary: NASA has publicly released over 800GB of data from the Artemis II mission. The extensive archive includes more than 11,000 photos and videos. It also features over 8.5 hours of audio and crew-annotated materials.

headline: Riftbound: Radiance Preview Highlights New Meta-Disrupting 'Deploy' Mechanic
summary: A hands-on preview of Riftbound's fifth set, Radiance, was conducted in Pre-Rift and sealed formats. Executive producer Chengran Chai discussed the new 'Deploy' mechanic. 'Deploy' is anticipated to significantly disrupt the game's current meta.

headline: Doom 2016 Composer Mick Gordon Blasts AI
summary: Mick Gordon, the acclaimed composer for Doom 2016, publicly expressed his strong disdain for AI. He used an expletive to convey his negative feelings towards artificial intelligence. This statement reflects his personal stance on the technology's role in creative fields.

headline: Mick Gordon Eager to Return to Doom Series
summary: Doom 2016 composer Mick Gordon expressed a strong desire to return to the Doom series. He stated he would rejoin the franchise 'in a heartbeat'. This indicates his continued passion for the game and its musical direction.

headline: Artemis Fowl Animated Series Greenlit for Disney+, Disney Channel
summary: An animated TV show based on the Artemis Fowl books has been greenlit. The series will air on Disney Channel and be available on Disney+. Author Eoin Colfer is confirmed to serve as an executive producer.

headline: Deloitte Accused of Aiding Abramovich in Tax Evasion
summary: A BBC investigation alleges Deloitte helped Roman Abramovich falsify documents to evade tax on his wealth. Backdated paperwork reportedly made the Russian oligarch's yachts and mansions disappear from accounts. The findings suggest a deliberate effort to obscure assets and avoid taxation.

headline: PM to Argue Rejecting Closer EU Ties is 'Dereliction of Duty'
summary: The Prime Minister is expected to address the Commons, emphasizing the importance of closer EU ties. He will argue that rejecting such a deal would be a 'dereliction of duty'. A new agreement with the EU could tackle illegal immigration and boost economic growth.

headline: Russell Brand Arrives in Court for Rape Trial
summary: Actor and comedian Russell Brand has arrived at court for the commencement of his rape trial. The 51-year-old faces charges of rape and sexual assault. He denies all allegations made by six women.

headline: Houthi Strike Kills One, Injures Eleven at Riyadh Airport
summary: A Houthi strike at Riyadh airport has resulted in one fatality and eleven injuries. This incident marks the second attack on the Saudi capital's airport within two days. The Iran-backed Yemeni group has launched multiple assaults on the region over the weekend.
